_readme: Editable, versioned tariff data. Add a new entry to `versions` when rates change; never edit old ones. An entry is only used if status is 'verified' AND effective_from AND categories are filled in. Fill `source` with the official notification (NEPRA/FESCO/Power Division) you copied the rates from.

versions.applicability: PLACEHOLDER. No rates have been verified against an official source. Do not use for estimates.
